name: Encrypted Scroll
summary: At Deathknell, a sealed message reaches a newly awakened Forsaken rogue. Shadow Priest Sarvis sends the recruit to David Trias after they prove ready.

sections.title: A Quiet Summons
sections.body: Newly raised Forsaken fight mindless zombies in the cemetery while Deathknell's leaders watch for those drawn to stealth and subterfuge. Once you prove ready, Shadow Priest Sarvis gives you a sealed parchment. David Trias's discreet seal marks an early link to the covert network beneath Forsaken leadership.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: David Trias watches Deathknell's crossroads and inn for prospects in future covert operations. The Forsaken need disciplined agents for their fledgling kingdom, not common thieves or reckless cutpurses. Trias says capable rogues may draw the notice of the Shadowstalkers, a Forsaken cadre that prizes cunning, precision, and absolute loyalty to the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Scroll?
faq.answer: The scroll privately invites a newly awakened Forsaken rogue to meet David Trias for specialized training. Shadow Priest Sarvis gives it to you once you prove capable.
David Trias is the rogue mentor at Deathknell's inn. He assesses fresh recruits and scouts prospects for larger Forsaken intelligence operations.

faq.q: Who are the Shadowstalkers mentioned by Trias?
faq.answer: The Shadowstalkers are Forsaken stealth operatives and assassins. They seek talented, disciplined agents rather than clumsy pickpockets.
Encryption shields sensitive messages from careless eyes in vulnerable Deathknell. For Forsaken rogues, it protects their communications and supports operational security.

faq.q: Where do you find Shadow Priest Sarvis?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis oversees the intake of newly awakened Forsaken in Deathknell's central crypt and chapel complex in Tirisfal Glades.
David Trias is inside Deathknell's damaged inn, just down the path from the central chapel.

angles.text: As a rogue, you receive a private summons into the Forsaken's covert network. Your first steps among the newly risen may lead to covert service.
As a newly formed Forsaken, you help secure Tirisfal Glades against the Scourge and living remnants. Scouts and covert agents are vital to the Dark Lady's survival strategy.
